source_text: Accesserunt capita Levitarum ad Eleazarum et Iesum — civitates cum suburbanis. Qui altari serviunt de oblatione vivunt.
pass_a_gloss: Approached heads of-Levites unto Eleazar and Jesus — cities with pasturelands. Who to-altar serve from offering live.
pass_b_english: [[Levitical heads approach Eleazar and Jesus — cities with pasturelands >> Bible:Joshua 21:1-3]]. Those who serve the altar live from the offering.
